summary: A side-scrolling action game, not an instrument: you play a beaver fighting through a robot city on the FM-1's screen, with synthesized music, effects and recorded character voices.
features: Played on the keys: movement, jump, fire, doors, firebombs and a posse
Bike and jetpack sections; health pickups and checkpoints
Progress saved to the device when paused; unlockable Golden Beaver run
Browser preview can play the game or mirror a connected FM-1
Recorder exports playthrough video with USB audio; needs macOS
